harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Locked the curl package on node1 at its current version (curl-7.76.1-31.el9.x86_64) using dnf versionlock, verified the lock excludes curl from a full system update, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed the lock and package version survived reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (AlmaLinux 9.6) and package manager (dnf) and current curl version (cmd-3c65ac667dda41d0)
Checked for versionlock plugin availability (cmd-e749cd907e6843dd) and installed dnf-command(versionlock) (cmd-efcfd37ecafd4cb0)
Added a versionlock on curl-0:7.76.1-31.el9.* and listed the lock (cmd-25eb5794e97d4db8)
Verified check-update/targeted update reports nothing to do for curl (cmd-579bd46005744356)
Confirmed versionlock plugin config/list file and ran a full dry-run system update (210 packages) that excludes curl (cmd-c2c0dfe88e4b42ab)
Grepped the dry-run output to confirm curl itself is absent from the upgrade set while libcurl (separate package) is listed (cmd-d59c27a146da460e)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime-since, curl version, versionlock list (cmd-e1ae0ef1e05e47e9)
Scheduled and triggered a reboot on node1 via backgrounded sudo reboot (cmd-0f5ef427de67485d)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again after connection resets (cmd-810ada1513e84fcb, cmd-786a7cd23a88462d, cmd-e5cf61b9ba2e4968)
Captured post-restart evidence: new boot_id, new uptime-since, curl still at same version, versionlock entry intact (cmd-57339661fd12436f)

evidence.requirement: curl package version-locked to current version on node1
evidence.summary: Identified curl-7.76.1-31.el9.x86_64, installed dnf-command(versionlock), and added/verified a versionlock entry pinning curl to that exact version.

evidence.requirement: Prove the lock actually prevents curl from being updated
evidence.summary: A full dry-run system update shows 210 packages (including libcurl) would upgrade, but the curl package itself is excluded from the transaction, confirming the versionlock is effective.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9, uptime-since 09:40:53, curl version, and active versionlock list before reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: restart acknowledgement and node unavailable during reboot
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection reset while node1 was rebooting.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: changed boot identity and recovered state
evidence.summary: Exec became available again; boot_id changed to a63b64e3-a5a8-4fd8-b8d5-4bb7a6d7e3f1 and uptime-since advanced to 09:41:54, proving a real restart. Post-restart curl remains 7.76.1-31.el9 and the versionlock entry persisted, confirming the hold survives the restart.

attempts.summary: Locked the curl package on node1 at its current version (curl-7.76.1-31.el9.x86_64) using dnf versionlock, verified the lock excludes curl from a full system update, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed the lock and package version survived reboot.
